projects.cardDescription: Chrome extension that detects bulk product listings and surfaces the real per-unit cost, highlighting the best deal.
projects.learnMoreContent:
Instantly find the best bulk deals. See price per item across Amazon, Walmart, AliExpress & Temu. Never overpay again!

Stop Overpaying for Bulk. See the Real Price with Pack Saver.
You know the feeling: you need to buy a multipack, but comparing the "$6.99 for a 100-pack" to the "$15.99 for a 400-pack" means pulling out a calculator. Shopping sites are designed to confuse you by sorting by total price, not by true value.

🤔 The Problem: The smaller, seemingly cheaper pack is often 60% more expensive per item than the larger one—and you'd never know without tedious math.

✅ The Pack Saver Solution: This extension instantly calculates the price per item for every bulk pack on the page. In seconds, you see which option genuinely saves you the most money.

🎯 What You Get: Instant, Effortless Savings
Best Deal Highlighted: A golden "Best Value" badge instantly points out the clear winner. No more guesswork.

Price Per Item: See the real cost comparison for every product.

Top 3 Deals Ranked: Quickly compare the three most cost-effective choices.

One-Click Savings: Jump straight to the best-value item with a single click.

💰 Supported Platforms:
Amazon, Walmart, AliExpress, & Temu

🔒 Privacy First: Zero Tracking, Always On
Pack Saver is a privacy-first tool. It performs all calculations directly in your browser. We have zero data collection, no tracking, and it works completely offline.

Stop overpaying for bulk. Install Pack Saver and let us find your real savings.
